Game Overview

Monster Dentist is a monster game built around help various quirky monsters regain their bright smiles after indulging in too much candy. Use an array of dental tools, focusing on one tooth at a time. Engage in this lighthearted, educational adventure that mixes fun and learning in a universe full of charming, unique creatures.

Playing Monster Dentist comes down to a simple loop. Help various quirky monsters regain their bright smiles after indulging in too much candy.
